Continuum IDE is a community fork of [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) (MIT). It is not an official T3 Code release.

## Downloads

| System                      | File                                     |
| --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Windows 10/11 x64           | `Continuum-IDE-Setup-x64.exe`            |
| Linux x64, any distribution | `Continuum-IDE-x86_64.AppImage`          |
| Debian / Ubuntu             | `Continuum-IDE-amd64.deb`                |
| Fedora / openSUSE           | `Continuum-IDE-x86_64.rpm` (if attached) |

Installers are **not code-signed**. On Windows choose **More info → Run anyway**. Verify files against `SHA256SUMS`.

Install and setup instructions: [README](https://github.com/SwashX-dev/continuum-ide#readme).
